name: Norms: the norm over time (Galán & Izquierdo Figs. 4–5)
description: Galán & Izquierdo's Figs. 4–5: the share of runs in which the norm has collapsed (mean boldness ≥ 6/7 and mean vengefulness ≤ 1/7) after 100, 1 000 and 10 000 generations. Axelrod ran 100. Measured (release, seeds 1–20, recorded 2026-09-26): the norms game 0.25, 1.00, 0.95; the metanorms game 0, 0, 0.05. The norms game's collapse is complete within 1 000 generations; the metanorms game's comes later — by 10⁵ generations 43 of 100 runs have collapsed (100 seeds, measured in planning; the survey's 50 seeds: 20 of 50), and Galán & Izquierdo's runs to 10⁶ show it usually does.
